reviews.t: Hinge immediately came detached upon first opening of clip
reviews.x: So disappointed. I’ve owned and loved the Camila AD 718 size 3.5 claw clip for years and have a hard time finding clips for my thick hair that don’t break. After receiving this, I immediately went to try it and bam, one side of the hinge came out.  I can’t fix it or use it and it’s too much hassle to return it. I would not recommend this clip at all and frankly will not purchase any product from Camila Paris again. I was expecting better quality product than the usual drug store hair clip consid

reviews.t: WAY TOO EXPENSIVE FOR THE POOR QUALITY
reviews.x: These are pretty, but they do not last.  Bought 3 of these clips, however 2 are broken after being worn 3-4 times. The pin holding the spring in place was not manufactured correctly it sticks out too far on one side and not far enough on the other.  Therefore on one side the arms holding each half together comes off where the spring is.  See photos.

reviews.t: Belle Époque decorative hair jaw clip
reviews.x: This is the 3.5 “amber” jaw clip. The color is more of a mauvey beige,and translucent. It is really pretty in person&in the hair! I have medium length,curly blondish hair Very tight jaw,won’t slip.The spring is a dark metal.It comes with a sheer bag stamped Camila Paris,so it could be a nice present too.

reviews.t: Perfect for fine hair:
reviews.x: Really good for my fine hair. Great quality. Functional for fine hair maybe not so much if you had really thick hair since they’re so small but they are perfect for me. I have a hard time finding any clips for my fine hair. Also very pretty.

reviews.t: Strong hold & nice appearance
reviews.x: I ordered the 1" tortoise clip that is somewhat clear but has a pleasant neutral brown color that can be worn with anything. The purpose is only to hold small sections of hair away from my face keeping it back off my face. It's a nice change from a headband. These are quality clips and have a strong, tight hold. They would also be good for younger girls. I'm an older woman that chooses to wear my hair longer than many women my age. If these were not so pricey (my only negative), I would definite

reviews.t: pretty
reviews.x: This is such a pretty comb especially for the price.  I just wish it were a tad larger.  My hair is pretty thick so I can't make a bun with it.  Just can twist it up like a short pony tail if that makes sense.

reviews.t: No good for thick or long hair
reviews.x: The length, profile and description of this clip indicate it is suited for long, thick hair.  It is not.  It can hold thin or average hair, but the design is such that the claws only open a very small width.  If you truly have thick hair you realize this will never work as there is no way to get the needed amount of hair into the clip itself without breaking it, especially if you are trying to put your hair up entirely.  The material is very lightweight And insubstantial as well, so there is jus

reviews.t: HInge for hair clip is gold, not silver as pictured.
reviews.x: This clip is very pretty, bought the 2" and it is tiny- I have fine hair and perhaps this is too small as it barely secures my hair and after awhile it starts to droop. Disappointed that the spring/hinge is gold color, prefer silver (only have silver jewelry). Also, I only ordered one 3.5" hair clip and I'm hoping it will be better size wise and hopefully have a silver spring/hinge. These hair clips are pricey, so I was hoping to treat myself to a few since I'd lost my favorite hair clip recentl

reviews.t: Cute little claw does the trick
reviews.x: Cute hair clips like these are hard to find. I have trouble finding claws at the store that keep all my hair up without dropping down to my neck by the end of the day.  PROS: -Looks adorable, goes with a lot of styles -keeps long, fine hair up all day with little to no readjustment -looks fragile, but is quite tough  CONS: -teeth are a bit sharp, so you could scratch yourself if not careful -sometimes hair gets caught in the spring mechanism on the spine of the clip

reviews.t: The claws are long enough to provide a great grip!
reviews.x: I ordered two more of these - one in a jade color (dark green) and the other in a blush color. The claws are long enough to actually wrap around the hair bundle which pleased me. I wish the clip itself was longer to allow for thicker hair. The cut-outs are charming and very feminine. I did have to file (nail file) the end of the claws a little because the mold left them with sharp tips that can dig into the scalp - no big deal, a 5-minute fix.

reviews.t: My Favorite Hair Clip
reviews.x: I bought this clip many years ago, I have fine thin hair, many clip couldn’t hold my hair. This one keep my hair up. i was looking to buy one more, but the store don’t carry it anymore, i keep searching at Amazon, i found it. i even willing to pay higher price.  very happy!!!

reviews.t: To see not to believe this product!
reviews.x: It’s a fragile product with misguided color ! I sincerely advice vendor that It’s not easy to build up a business reputation but it’s easy to ruin it by “Manipulating” customers’ trust!

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: Great clip!  You really get what you pay for.  Your hair will stay up all day.  I have thick hair, and it works beautifully for me.

reviews.t: Hairy situation
reviews.x: This should not be under for thick hair search. It is shallow and barely grasps all my hair.

reviews.t: It is a green clip.  Nothing spectacular and not worth the money
reviews.x: I was looking so forward to getting it.  The pics looked like it would be a a beautiful jade color with intricate detail.  Nope.  It's just a green clip.  Seems sturdy enough but nothing worth $10.  I've had better for a lot less.  Lesson learned

reviews.t: As advertised
reviews.x: I was happily surprised when I opened it and it was exactly the right size. Sometimes when you order things will come smaller but no this was exactly as advertised. It's pretty and has a strong hold. Would buy again.

reviews.t: Very thin plastic
reviews.x: These hair clips are very poor quality. The plastic is very thin. I am returning these. I added a photo of another clip that Camila sells that has thicker plastic and I plan on keeping.

reviews.t: Pretty, but impractical
reviews.x: I ordered a couple of different designs from this company and although they're pretty, they don't hold much hair and the grip isn't very strong, so I wasn't thrilled.

reviews.t: Nice size
reviews.x: The plastic isn't as thick as I thought it would be, but it is still sturdy and doesn't feel flimsy. Keeps my hair back throughout my shift.

reviews.t: lovely
reviews.x: Bought this pretty hair clip as a thank you gift for my mom, she loved it! Very well made and easy to use for quick up-dos.

reviews.t: The pin fell out that connects the two halves, and it broke first time I used it.
reviews.x: I was able to push the pin back in, but it slips out every time I open the hair clip. Beautiful clip, bad design.

reviews.t: Cute! Buy it
reviews.x: Very cute color, and works well. Hasn’t broken and I’ve had it for a few months already!!

reviews.t: Interesting piece...not sure about the plastic quality
reviews.x: This is the third time I'm purchasing a hair clip from this company. Previously I got two narrower pieces with simpler designs, and I was happy with the hard resin-like plastic material they used. This one has a more elaborate design, but the plastic is much thinner and it has a give that makes me think it may not last as long or may break. I have thick hair so this may not be an issue for others. It does hold a decent amount of hair.

reviews.t: Superior hold for all hair types including very long & extra thick hair like mine.
reviews.x: I've tried more hair claws in my life than I would care to count. Most of them were just ok & some were good but none could compare to this exceptional hair claw. It keeps my hair in place through hours of rigorous outdoor play like running & jumping, without the need to readjust. The BEST HAIR CLAW EVER! I only wish I had discovered it years ago.

reviews.t: Company is completely incompetent.
reviews.x: This barrette is fine once I FINALLY received it. The amazingly incompetent company sent a black one. I wrote to say I had ordered green. They sent 2 more black ones before finally getting it right about 2 months later. Lucky it was not a gift! I threw the black ones away. The green is nicer than the black for sure.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the clips pretty and well-suited to fine or thin hair, holding it securely.
Several reviewers report the clips are too small or shallow for thick or long hair, despite descriptions suggesting otherwise.
Some reviewers experienced breakage or manufacturing defects, especially with the hinge or spring pin.
A few reviewers feel the clips are overpriced for the quality or not worth the money.
Some reviewers note color or appearance differs from the photos.
